question: A healthy 31-year-old woman comes to the physician because she is trying to conceive. She is currently timing the frequency of intercourse with at-home ovulation test kits. An increase in the levels of which of the following is the best indicator that ovulation has occurred?
analysis: The best indicator that ovulation has occurred is a surge in luteinizing hormone (LH). This surge triggers the release of the egg from the ovary. While estrogen and progesterone levels change during the menstrual cycle, it is the LH surge that directly indicates that ovulation is imminent or has occurred.
